semantics.clock: All sequential logic samples at rising clk edges; one serial bit per edge.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset overrides reception, returns to idle and clears done. No power-up initialization is required before reset. out_byte is unspecified unless done=1.
semantics.framing: Idle high samples are ignored. Idle low is a start bit. The next eight edges sample data bits 0 through 7, least significant first. The ninth edge after start samples stop.
semantics.completion: An expected stop sample of 1 makes done high immediately after that edge for one cycle and makes out_byte equal the eight captured bits. The next edge can accept a new low start bit; idle highs never assert done.
semantics.error: An expected stop sample of 0 discards the frame without done. Ignore subsequent lows until a high sample restores idle; this recovery high does not assert done. Reception can start on the following edge.
semantics.reset_during_frame: Reset aborts any partial frame or recovery wait; reception begins again after reset is released.

numeric.payload: Unsigned 8-bit bit pattern, received bit k maps to out_byte[k].
numeric.counter: An unsigned 3-bit counter selects indices 0 through 7; no payload arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow behavior is needed.

verification.oracle: Independent bit-stream scoreboard counts samples since a start; reconstructs byte by bit index and rejects malformed stop bits, comparing done on every edge and byte only when done.
verification.directed: Idle; all 256 byte values; consecutive frames; invalid stop with extended low recovery; recovery high; reset in each reception phase and error recovery; synchronous reset between edges.
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random serial bits and resets checked by the same protocol oracle.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, followed by matching vvp; finite timeout for each compile and simulation. No official tests or synthesis.

specification_ambiguities.text: Assert done each time it finds a stop bit could include a late recovery high.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Only correctly received bytes assert done, consistent with the byte validity requirement; recovery high resynchronizes without completion.
